description: Physical drawing-imprecision illustration, not a counterexample to unique ideal-line incidence. Two finite, slightly curved, near-coincident ink traces have distinct outer ends and overlap near two close crossmark regions. The marks and ink have visible width, not ideal zero-size point identities. No line objects, common-two-point incidence, inferred exact intersections, labels, units or arrows. Modern clean path shapes are illustrative choices; trace continuity through the source's overlapping ink cannot be attributed uniquely. The legal 640x320 canvas adds white vertical margin without stretching the narrow illustration. Targeted readability repair: the same two trace centerlines are bounded by filled 3.5-pixel ribbons, so ink width scales with the complete canvas and does not obscure the crossmarks at 240px.

authoritativeText.text:
例如，几何中经过任意两个不同的点有一条而且只有一条直线。
实际作图时，仅仅在两个点离得不很近的情况下，才能相信经过图上两个已知点只能作一条直线（图 74）。
可以设想一下：在莫斯科学校的教室里，沿铅直方向上下作两个点，距离为 $10\,\mathrm{cm}$（图 75）。

从几何的观点来说，连接这两点的直线通过地球并且穿过地表面以后，应当到达某一确定的点。
实际上，我们不能完全准确地指出这一点。
它的位置在太平洋的南部，但是只能指出它的大概位置。

我们看到，几何概念是抽象的概念。
实际的体不仅有确定的形状和大小，而且有质量，可能是铁质的、木质的，等等。
除了实际的体的形状和大小以外，忽略其余所有性质，就可以得到几何体的形象。

忽略体的某些尺寸，就得到几何的面和线的形象，最后得到几何的点的形象。
但是，现代的几何学家宁愿采用相反的途径。
他们把线、面、体以及几何图形都看作是点的集合。

不妨向自己提出这样的问题：为什么要讲上面这些话呢？
为什么需要这种抽象呢？
问题的答复是：因为仅仅对于抽象的几何图形才能叙述许多简单和极其重要的命题。

Exact source left-to-right trace identity is unresolved; chosen complete paths are not measured ideal lines. Actual preview must show all four ends and the overlapping middle.

Source: left close crossmark region, two short crossing strokes. Literal segment endpoints are drawing construction, not the abstract marked point and not any incidence assertion about both ink traces.
Source: second nearby crossmark region, two short crossing strokes; distinct from the first mark. Drawing endpoints and visible width do not define two shared ideal-line points.
